description: Sets the show cover art. image is base64 JPEG or PNG, at most 1 MiB decoded. It must be a square between 1400 and 3000 px, and the bytes must match contentType, or the call is rejected. Send a 1400 × 1400 px square, RGB with no transparency; resize a smaller one up first. Free. Call this only while the show has the PodBox default cover, or when the person asks for a new show cover. To check, read the feed at the feed_url link: the channel <itunes:image> href ends in /covers/show.png while the show has the default. Any other href is a cover the person or another agent already set; keep it, even when you could make a better one.
name: set_cover
title: Set cover
